capabilities: Sync a vault with a Git repository
Merge concurrent edits line by line
Keep both versions when edits conflict
Create one commit per sync named by device and changes
Set up provider tokens and repository selection
extras: No telemetry; the access token is stored in Obsidian's keychain and never synced. Git over HTTPS only; files over 100 MB are skipped.
problem: Obsidian users who want Git versioning and cross-device sync on mobile otherwise need an external git client and manual conflict handling.

relations.evidence: Turn the Git plugin off on devices that use Easy Git Sync.
